reviews.body: Dorset Rewires were brilliant from start to finish. Great communication, turned up when they said they would, and carried out the work to a really high standard. Everything was left tidy and they were professional throughout. Would definitely recommend and use again.
reviews.author: Max Jones

reviews.body: These guys were fantastic, they wired my new build house in Lilliput and the work was perfect. Very tidy tradesmen and very easy to work with. Highly recommend and will use for any electrical work moving forward. Thanks
reviews.author: Jake C

reviews.body: Thank you to Pete, who wired up our heat pump in Parkstone, he then proceeded to set it up to operate at its maximum efficiency, this was completed in January 2026 but I wanted to give it a good test before leaving this 5 star review, highly recommend and will be using him again for other electrical work.
